messages:
maria: heads-up — after last night's RBAC tweak I see a spike in mTLS handshake rejects between eu-west proxies and ap-southeast clients (started ~03:12 UTC). audit shows gaps for some rejects.
aj: saw alerts, suspect KMS role/credential mismatch. which services are failing?
maria: proxy-eu (ingress) and proxy-apac (edge), plus internal python SDKs for analytics.
taylor: how big is the gap in audit logs? are we missing accept/reject pairs or entire events?
maria: ~30% of rejects don't have corresponding audit entries in the collector; the rest do. looks like sampling gone weird or collector backfill failed.
security-bot: :warning: alert 2543219876: cert_revocation_mismatch detected for client_id=svc-analytics, rule=CRL_OCSP_DELTA (severity=high)
samir: can we get a TLS debug snippet from proxy logs? paste minimal sanitized output.
maria: paste log snippet:
```
[2026-03-20T03:14:22Z] PROXY TLS: CLIENT_HELLO ip=10.100.23.45 sni=analytics.internal.redwood cipher=TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256
[2026-03-20T03:14:22Z] CERT_CHAIN client_cert_id=0x1234abcd chain_len=3 intermediate=fallback-int.pem
[2026-03-20T03:14:22Z] OCSP: stapled=false fetched_status=unauthorized
[2026-03-20T03:14:22Z] KMS: decrypt=FAIL key_id=projects/kv/my-key version=2 error="NOT_FOUND"
```
aj: KMS NOT_FOUND during decrypt usually indicates key version rotation without updating the role binding for the decrypter. Did the RBAC change remove a role?
samir: checking IAM diffs now — there's a change: removed role "roles/kms.decryptor" from serviceAccount:proxy-sa-eu in the last PR (1684). looks accidental.
taylor: that would explain KMS failures and then the proxy falling into fallback path that doesn't emit audit events.
maria: can we hotfix? proxies support runtime keystore reload via internal ops endpoint. no full redeploy needed. command: `curl -X POST https://ops.internal/proxy-eu/reload-keystore -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN"`
aj: i can run that. but first we should re-add the role in IAM to avoid immediate reoccurrence. who can patch that?
samir: i'll re-grant the role to proxy-sa-eu in IAM, then aj can reload. also adding a preflight check to deploy pipeline to fail if role removals are detected.
ops-bot: note: auditing config shows collector ingestion at 03:10–03:20 had intermittent CPU pressure; sample-rate temporarily increased to relieve backpressure.
taylor: ops-bot — can collector backfill missing events? we need rejects mapped to users for compliance.
ops-bot: yes — audit-collector has a backfill API: POST /backfill with body `{start_ts, end_ts, filter}`. note that backfill will only import events available in the buffered store; if proxy dropped events before forwarding they are lost.
maria: we should also reconcile OCSP/CRL — some clients presented certs issued by an intermediate that was revoked but not yet reflected in internal CRL cache. plan: enable strict OCSP enforcement internally and rotate client certs to ephemeral short TTL.
taylor: hard-failing unknown OCSP for all external traffic is risky; propose a phased rollout: enable hard-fail for internal prefixes (/internal/*, svc-mgmt) and monitor for 24h, then expand.
aj: re-added role to IAM and reloaded keystore on proxy-eu now. monitoring...
(5m)
aj: rates: handshake rejects on proxy-eu fell from 7.1% -> 0.6%. audit gap reduced. :tada:
maria: excellent. follow-ups: 1) schedule sweep across regions to check for missing kms.decryptor role on all proxy service accounts 2) patch deploy pipeline with IAM preflight that diffs role removals 3) set internal OCSP hard-fail gate + client cert TTL -> 24h ephemeral 4) run audit-collector backfill for 03:00–04:00 window and attach to INC-2026-1873.
samir: added preflight task to security board (SEC-482).
taylor: running a quick script: `python infra/scripts/check_sa_roles.py --role roles/kms.decryptor --regions eu apac us` — results: 3 missing in apac (svc-batch, svc-ingest, proxy-apac). will patch tonight at 02:00 UTC with rolling approach.
maria: thanks. also adding a small probe to the observability dashboard to alert if OCSP fetch returns non-OK >0.5% for 10m.
ops-bot: incident INC-2026-1873 created and linked to runbook gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/sec-runbooks/ocsp-kms-rbac-fix (private).
maria: closing loop — incident status set to monitoring. will follow up with postmortem including why preflight didn't catch the IAM change.
aj: assigning myself to implement preflight and coordinate patches.
taylor: i'll own the OCSP hard-fail rollout plan and dashboard probe.
samir: i'll author an automated IAM-diff check that runs on PRs touching infra roles.
maria: thanks team — great quick response. documenting timeline in ticket and will share with compliance. :white_check_mark:
